schema_version.description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

claim_id.description: This identifier refers to one extracted teacher claim.

unit_id.description: This identifier refers to the exact reviewed detection unit.

decision.description: Whether the listener identified or accepted the original heard target. This is separate from whether their proposed repair or explanation is correct.

duplicate_of_claim_id.description: This identifier refers to an earlier compatible nonduplicate claim.

category_id.description: This field contains the mapped category that the teacher explicitly supplied.

supplied.description: This flag records whether the source teacher text actually contains the relevant component.

option_id.description: An existing comparison rubric for the listener proposal. Its gold text is not the listener's proposal. A definite rejected repair can have null here when no valid option matches; null never grants positive credit.

satisfied_proposition_ids.description: IDs of reference conditions actually satisfied by the listener's correction wording. Do not copy IDs merely because they appear in the gold key. Reference text and listener text are different subjects.

violated_proposition_ids.description: These existing forbidden propositions occur in the actual teacher response.

status.description: Semantic correctness of the LISTENER'S actual supplied correction, not processing success, not correct detection, and not correctness of the reference key. A matched_error decision does not imply accepted correction.

support_evidence_ids.description: These IDs identify existing evidence within the judgment scope.

unresolved_reason.description: This code states why the correction or explanation cannot receive a resolved judgment.

items.description: An additional substantive assertion in this component, judged independently from other components.

end_cp.description: Original answer Unicode codepoint end, exclusive.

exact_text.description: Literal original answer slice; no rewritten teacher assertion.

judgment.description: Contextual semantic truth/support judgment, not a numeric grade.

reason.description: Case/rule-grounded explanation, or explicit unknown reason.

additional_assertions.description: Exact original listener assertions and their contextual truth, including overbroad or distorted versions of a rule even when part of the sentence also satisfies a narrower required proposition.

correction.description: Independent correction assessment; rationale assertions cannot cancel a valid repair.

supplied.description: This flag records whether the source teacher text actually contains the relevant component.

option_id.description: Always null: explanation conditions come from unit.rationale_required_propositions and unit.rationale_forbidden_propositions, not correction options.

satisfied_proposition_ids.description: IDs of reference conditions actually satisfied by the listener's explanation wording. Do not copy IDs merely because they appear in the gold key. Reference text and listener text are different subjects.

violated_proposition_ids.description: These existing forbidden propositions occur in the actual teacher response.

status.description: Semantic correctness of the LISTENER'S actual supplied explanation, not processing success, not correct detection, and not correctness of the reference key. A matched_error decision does not imply accepted explanation.

support_evidence_ids.description: These IDs identify existing evidence within the judgment scope.

unresolved_reason.description: This code states why the correction or explanation cannot receive a resolved judgment.

items.description: A source-quoted explanation assertion judged in its full scope, including rubric-covered and additional assertions; at least one actual assessment for a supplied reason, unless explicitly unresolved.

end_cp.description: Original answer Unicode codepoint end, exclusive.

exact_text.description: Literal original answer slice; no rewritten teacher assertion.

judgment.description: Contextual semantic truth/support judgment, not a numeric grade.

reason.description: Case/rule-grounded explanation, or explicit unknown reason.

additional_assertions.description: Exact original listener assertions and their contextual truth, including overbroad or distorted versions of a rule even when part of the sentence also satisfies a narrower required proposition.

explanation.description: Optional explanation assessment even when task flag is false; absence is not a primary-grade penalty.

evidence_ids.description: These IDs identify actual supporting records within the permitted subject and version scope.

reason_code.description: This code states the supported cause for the mapping outcome.

note.description: This text records contextual information without authority to override a failed gate.

decisions.description: These records contain one supported outcome for every extracted claim.
